correctedCritiques.con-reliability-parsimony-justify-use: Strongest feature: The reply substitutes a fallibilist criterion for unattainable certainty, grounding rational reliance in persistent reliability, shared experience, practical survival, and parsimony while candidly acknowledging its presupposition of shared reality. Principal limitation: Instrumental success justifies continued reliance without resolving why logical relations and natural regularities obtain, leaving operational warrant separable from ultimate metaphysical explanation. Live burden: The negative must establish that the motion demands demonstrated divine necessity rather than causal understanding, while explaining how reliability escapes objectionable circularity and warrants more than convenience. Locked score: The very strong band reflects excellent calibration, responsiveness, charity, and burden contact, tempered because the pragmatic reframing leaves ultimate grounding unanswered and employs the shared reality whose absolute justification it disclaims.
correctedCritiques.pro-personal-god-unifies-categories: Strongest feature: The move recognizes transcendental categories as interrelated without being identical and proposes a personal unifier, advancing beyond simplistic reductions of logic, knowledge, or universals to sensory information. Principal limitation: Materialism is pronounced self-contradictory without demonstration, while the transition from categorical interrelation to a personal God remains underdeveloped and leaves the circularity and parsimony objections unanswered. Live burden: The affirmative must articulate missing premises, identify which materialist commitment produces contradiction, and explain why categorical integration requires personality and Orthodox specificity instead of structural coherence or primitive relations. Locked score: The weak band reflects relevance and syllogistic direction, outweighed by incomplete argumentation, undelimited alternatives, responsiveness to objections, and overstatement of materialist failure and theological necessity.
